digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions workflows — mirror CI policy
propositions: Mirror CI workflows on push to main cancel each other due to shared concurrency group, rendering healthy main as red X on GitHub commit list
Cancellation defeats per-commit attribution and obscures the actual CI signal (whether main is currently healthy)
Four major Gerrit-primary mirrors (Go, OpenStack, LibreOffice, AOSP) run no per-commit CI on GitHub mirrors; real post-merge signals live in separate systems (LUCI, Zuul, etc.)

Scheduled (not push-triggered) main health checks every 6 hours replace per-commit tracking, surfacing only current health; bisect recipes and last-known-green SHA are published on failure for rapid remediation
Pre-merge gating via Gerrit Verified lane is unaffected; the change alters only when the safety net runs, not what gates a merge
